//: The test sources `tsconfig.base.json` keeps out of every package's build,
type-checked here instead so excluding them from the product output does
not quietly stop checking them. Nothing emits: this config exists to fail.
It is deliberately not part of any package. The image runs `pnpm build`
and nothing else, so the moment a package's own tsconfig reaches a test
file the build needs `test/support/tagged/compat.mjs` in the build
context — which is the failure this arrangement removes.
The `.test.tsx` patterns match nothing today; they mirror the base config's
exclude so a first one cannot land unchecked. `apps/web` is not here: its
tests sit in `tests/`, which its own `include` (`src/**`) never reached,
so the base exclude takes nothing away from it.
